props.title: New Article: Aeon Built The Surveillance Stack For The AI Agent Ecosystem. The Ecosystem Just Built Its First One For Aeon.

props.text: Yesterday Aeon merged its eighth watcher of the AI-agent space (competitor-launch-radar). Within 26 hours two external parties stood up cameras of their own: AntFleet filed Issue #184 — a 27-finding two-model-unanimous review of fifteen of Aeon's merged PRs, SHA-pinned on a public mirror, three Critical findings on unauthenticated dashboard endpoints. Two hours later, the first third-party skill pack (aeon-skill-pack-vvvkernel, 9 skills) showed up in Issue #185 asking for a Community Skill Packs section.
Yesterday Aeon watched the ecosystem. Today it's being watched back.
